method: Simulated cold on the dev PC (no reboot): Adperastra WebView2 child processes stopped, profile kept. first_paint = PrintWindow pixel of the startup skeleton/content; content_ready = session.json written by the app. True after-reboot numbers: run scripts/measure-startup.ps1 after a reboot.

first_ever_run.note: One-time: creates the WebView2 profile. Documented one-time cost; the startup skeleton is inline in index.html and paints before any JS loads.

verdict: Warm and cold-process starts are inside the Fast tier.
